faq.q: How many homes are for sale in Ranch Park?
faq.a: At the end of September 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 20 houses and 1 condos and townhomes listed in Ranch Park. Those are month-end counts and they move daily, so ask Jared for a current list.

faq.q: Is Ranch Park a buyers’ or sellers’ market?
faq.a: In September 2026, houses had a sales ratio of 20% (a balanced market); condos and townhomes had 100% on only 1 listed, too few to read as a market type. The sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed; on the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers. One month in one community is a small sample, so look at the monthly table above before you decide.

faq.q: How many homes sold in Ranch Park from June to September 2026?
faq.a: 9 houses and 3 condos and townhomes sold in Ranch Park over those 4 months; detached houses peaked in September with 4 sold and condos and townhomes peaked in June with 2 sold.

faq.q: How big is Ranch Park compared with the rest of Coquitlam?
faq.a: In September 2026, Ranch Park held 4.7% of the 425 detached houses listed in Coquitlam and 0.1% of the 806 condos and townhomes listed in Coquitlam.

faq.q: What mix of houses and condos is for sale in Ranch Park?
faq.a: In September 2026, houses made up 95.2% of the 21 homes listed in Ranch Park and condos and townhomes made up 4.8%; of the 5 that sold, houses were 80.0% and condos and townhomes 20.0%.

faq.q: Are there more or fewer homes for sale in Ranch Park than in June?
faq.a: Listings of detached houses fell from 41 in June to 20 in September 2026 (−51.2%); condos and townhomes was 1 in June and 1 in September 2026, too few (under 3) to call a rise or fall.
